mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope(organization_unit_id,include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id,include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND scope_type='ORGANIZATION' AND active=TRUE UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id,TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope p ON child.parent_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.include_descendants=TRUE)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM visible_scope s JOIN seal.organization_unit o USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE s.organization_unit_id=#{organizationId} AND o.active=TRUE)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seal.recipient WHERE organization_unit_id=#{organizationId} AND email_lookup_hmac=#{emailHmac} AND recipient_status='ACTIVE')
SELECT b.* FROM seal.recipient_import_batch b JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE b.recipient_import_batch_id=#{batchId}
SELECT b.* FROM seal.recipient_import_batch b JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE b.recipient_import_batch_id=#{batchId} FOR UPDATE OF b
SELECT * FROM seal.recipient_import_row WHERE recipient_import_batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY row_number
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.recipient_import_row SET affiliation_name=NULL,job_title=NULL,collection_basis=NULL,recipient_name_ciphertext=NULL,recipient_email_ciphertext=NULL,encryption_key_id=NULL,email_lookup_hmac=NULL,row_status='IMPORTED',error_codes=NULL,imported_recipient_id=#{recipientId} WHERE recipient_import_batch_id=#{batchId} AND row_number=#{rowNumber} AND row_status='VALID'

UPDATE seal.recipient_import_row SET affiliation_name=NULL,job_title=NULL,collection_basis=NULL,recipient_name_ciphertext=NULL,recipient_email_ciphertext=NULL,encryption_key_id=NULL,email_lookup_hmac=NULL,row_status=CASE WHEN row_status='ERROR' THEN 'ERROR' ELSE 'PURGED' END WHERE recipient_import_batch_id=#{batchId} AND row_status IN('DUPLICATE','ERROR')

UPDATE seal.recipient_import_batch SET import_status='IMPORTED',imported_count=#{importedCount},completed_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE recipient_import_batch_id=#{batchId} AND import_status='VALIDATED'
mapper.select: WITH due AS (SELECT recipient_import_batch_id FROM seal.recipient_import_batch WHERE import_status='VALIDATED' AND expires_at<=#{now} ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), purged AS (UPDATE seal.recipient_import_row r SET affiliation_name=NULL,job_title=NULL,collection_basis=NULL,recipient_name_ciphertext=NULL,recipient_email_ciphertext=NULL,encryption_key_id=NULL,email_lookup_hmac=NULL,row_status=CASE WHEN r.row_status='ERROR' THEN 'ERROR' ELSE 'PURGED' END FROM due WHERE r.recipient_import_batch_id=due.recipient_import_batch_id AND r.row_status IN('VALID','DUPLICATE','ERROR') RETURNING r.recipient_import_batch_id), updated AS (UPDATE seal.recipient_import_batch b SET import_status='EXPIRED',version_no=version_no+1 FROM due WHERE b.recipient_import_batch_id=due.recipient_import_batch_id RETURNING b.recipient_import_batch_id) SELECT count(*) FROM updated
